title: Fix BootstrapGate loopback detection bypass when HttpContext is null
description: BootstrapGate.Authorize checks HttpContext?.Connection.RemoteIpAddress for loopback detection. When HttpContext is null (test context), the loopback check always returns true, bypassing authorization. Document that null HttpContext means loopback; consider making loopback detection injectable for testability. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P2-025
